headline: COP31 in Antalya closes in on final climate deal after overtime
summary_1line: Nearly 200 countries at COP31 in Antalya negotiated a third and 'final' text into Sunday morning after drafts stripped of fossil-fuel language drew threats of walkout, with a closing plenary set for later Sunday.

headline: Iran attacks US bases in Bahrain; industrial site fire
summary_1line: Iran's IRGC claimed missile-and-drone attacks on two US bases in Bahrain (Sheikh Isa and Juffair), and Bahrain said a civilian industrial facility on Sitra Island was hit and set on fire, with no injuries reported.

headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missile and drone
summary_1line: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a ballistic missile and a drone launched toward western Saudi Arabia and Riyadh as Houthi attacks on Taiz killed one and wounded seven, deepening Gulf escalation.

headline: Russia double-tap strike on Kryvyi Rih kills two, wounds 60
summary_1line: Ballistic missiles and follow-up drone strikes on Zelensky's hometown Kryvyi Rih killed a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic and wounded 60, part of a barrage of 27 ballistic missiles, 84 cruise missiles and 404 drones.

headline: Russian missiles and drone land in Poland; NATO vows to defend every inch
summary_1line: A Kh-101 cruise missile, a second missile and a jet-powered drone fell in southeastern Poland near Coalition-of-the-Willing exercises; Tusk called it an intentional provocation and NATO chief Rutte pledged 'NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory'.

headline: FBI probes suspected hack of US criminal-justice database
summary_1line: The FBI is investigating a suspected breach of the nationwide database used by federal, state and local law enforcement to share warrants, criminal histories and background checks.

headline: Trump proposes 10% cap on credit card interest rates
summary_1line: President Trump said he would back a 10% cap on credit card interest rates with Democrats' support, and again criticised the Federal Reserve's rate policy, citing India's 7% growth.

headline: Anthropic IPO draws $120 billion retail demand
summary_1line: Anthropic's share sale attracted about $120 billion in retail demand and over $500 billion institutional interest, even as the stock fell nearly 15% on Friday; an Anthropic mathematician separately claimed Claude helped solve the Riemann hypothesis.

headline: Voyager becomes first human-made object 1 light-day from Earth
summary_1line: Forty-nine years after launch, NASA's Voyager spacecraft became the first human-made object to sit one light-day away from Earth, a milestone in deep-space exploration.

headline: ICJ finds evidence of Rohingya genocide; Myanmar rejects ruling
summary_1line: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar's forces committed genocide against the Rohingya, targeting 800,000 people and killing about 10,000; Myanmar called the verdict unfair while Malaysia moves to resettle 10,000 Rohingya.

headline: Boat capsized in Nigeria's Bayelsa state, at least 24 dead
summary_1line: A boat carrying mourners to a burial ceremony capsized in Nigeria's Bayelsa state, killing at least 24 people; 24 others were rescued and the operator fled the scene, police said.

headline: Supercell storm devastates southern Brazil town, kills 3
summary_1line: A supercell storm with 114 kmph winds tore through Tupanciretã in Rio Grande do Sul, killing three, injuring 162 and damaging around 8,000 homes, forcing nearly all of the town's 20,000 residents to leave.

headline: Australia chase record 188 to beat England in MCG T20 opener
summary_1line: Australia beat world number one England by three wickets in the first T20 at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, completing the highest successful run chase at the ground and ending England's seven-match winning streak.

headline: Dutch court bars BYD SUV in Europe over Defender resemblance
summary_1line: The Hague court ruled BYD's Fangchengbao Ti7 infringes the EU design of JLR's Defender, barring its sale in Europe and production at BYD's planned Hungary plant pending resolution.
